hook_text: I'm Ranger Themba. That cold wind this morning? That was your Geography homework introducing itself.
clip_script:
I'm Ranger Themba. That freezing wind you felt on your walk to school this morning... that was your Geography homework introducing itself. 

That wasn't just random weather. That was a massive, swirling engine of air rolling off the ocean. We call it a mid-latitude cyclone.

Imagine two huge armies meeting. Warm air from the tropics, and freezing air from Antarctica. Where they crash, that’s the front.

The cold air is heavy. It acts like a bulldozer, shoving the warm air straight up into the sky. And when warm air is forced up fast... BAM. You get massive clouds, dropping heavy rain and thunderstorms.

So next time you feel that wind drop and the temperature plummet... you’ll know exactly what engine is driving it.
visual_style: Outdoor-feeling, warm, practical. Start with the tutor looking straight into the camera as if outside. As he mentions the 'bulldozing', quick cut to simple, clean whiteboard animation showing blue triangles wedging under a red area.
pacing: Fast opening hook, slowing down for the 'two armies' analogy, then speeding up for the 'BAM' heavy rain moment.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to see the whole storm unfold.
